newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Surplus funds keep Pakistan money rates soft.
newsitem.headline: Surplus funds keep Pakistan money rates soft.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates remained soft on Monday and are likely to remain at low levels on Tuesday owing to surplus funds, dealers said.
The market remained surplus as the State (central) Bank of Pakistan picked up less amounts in its open market operations last week, one dealer said.
The rates remained between 1.0 and 2.0 percent throughout the day on Monday, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
The rates are likely to remain at the same levels on Tuesday, he said. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
